tools.name: bridge_get_started
tools.description: Step-by-step plan to add the official WhatsApp Business API to the user's own CRM/SaaS with WasapFlow Bridge: account, keys, webhook URL, Connect WhatsApp button inside the user's own system, first message. Call this first when someone wants to build or connect WhatsApp. No partner key needed.

tools.name: bridge_docs_search
tools.description: Search the WasapFlow Bridge API reference, partner guide and changelog. Returns matching sections with a preview. Use before writing integration code. No partner key needed.

tools.name: bridge_docs_section
tools.description: Return the full text of one section (with its sub-sections) of the WasapFlow Bridge docs, e.g. "Verify Incoming Webhooks", "Send Template Message", "Webhook Event Payloads", "Error Codes". No partner key needed.

tools.name: bridge_list_numbers
tools.description: List the WhatsApp Business Accounts (client numbers) registered to this partner, with status.

tools.name: bridge_number_status
tools.description: Live status of a number from Meta: verified name, quality rating, messaging limit, name status.

tools.name: bridge_connect_link
tools.description: Create a short-lived (30 min) link that a business opens to connect its WhatsApp number through Meta Embedded Signup (Coexistence supported). Your system should open the returned connect_url for the client, normally behind its own "Connect WhatsApp" button; use this tool to test that flow.

tools.name: bridge_send_text
tools.description: Send a text message from a connected number. Free-form text only reaches people who messaged that number in the last 24 hours; otherwise use bridge_send_template. This sends a real message.

tools.name: bridge_send_template
tools.description: Send an approved template (works outside the 24-hour window). components follows the Meta Cloud API format. This sends a real message and Meta may charge for it.

tools.name: bridge_send_marketing
tools.description: Send an approved MARKETING template through Meta's Marketing Messages API (quality-based delivery, marketing metrics). Not onboarded yet? Meta falls back to Cloud API unless product_policy is STRICT. This sends a real message and Meta charges for it.

tools.name: bridge_list_templates
tools.description: List the message templates of a number with their approval status.

tools.name: bridge_failed_webhooks
tools.description: Webhook events Bridge could not deliver to your webhook URL (with the error). Bridge retries each one automatically for 24 hours (1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 8h, then every 8h); auto_retry shows the next attempt, and final=true means the schedule ended and the event needs bridge_retry_webhooks. Us

tools.name: bridge_retry_webhooks
tools.description: Redeliver one failed webhook event (event_id) or all of them (omit event_id) after the webhook endpoint is fixed.

tools.name: bridge_usage
tools.description: Current Bridge plan: active WhatsApp numbers, slots and the monthly Bridge fee.

tools.name: bridge_open_ticket
tools.description: Open a WasapFlow support ticket. Include what happened, when (with timezone), the exact error (Meta code, fbtrace_id), what was tried and the business impact.

tools.name: bridge_list_tickets
tools.description: List support tickets and replies status.

tools.name: bridge_call_api
tools.description: Call any WasapFlow Bridge endpoint not covered by the other tools (see bridge_docs_search for paths). Irreversible endpoints need {"confirm": true} in the body. Confirm with the user before any call that sends, deletes or changes something.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bridge_get_started, bridge_list_templates, bridge_open_ticket, bridge_list_tickets · Public sink: bridge_get_started, bridge_docs_section, bridge_send_text, bridge_send_template, bridge_send_marketing, bridge_failed_webhooks, bridge_retry_webhooks · Destructive: bridge_send_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bridge_get_started, bridge_list_templates, bridge_open_ticket, bridge_list_tickets · Public sink: bridge_get_started, bridge_docs_section, bridge_send_text, bridge_send_template, bridge_send_marketing, bridge_failed_webhooks, bridge_retry_webhooks · Destructive: bridge_send_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "bridge_get_started" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
